description_en: Configures the O\&M approval setting in a control policy
description_zh: 设置指定控制策略的运维审批配置
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost set-policy-approval-config --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 7 --approval-config SwitchStatus=On --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetPolicyApprovalConfig

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
可通过调用DescribeInstances接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the control policy that you want to modify.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html operation to query the control policy ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定需要修改的控制策略ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: policy_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable O\&M approval in the control policy. Valid values:

On: enables O\&M approval.

Off: disables O\&M approval
fields.help_zh:
控制策略中的运维审批配置。取值：

On：开启运维审批
Off：关闭运维审批
fields.name: switch_status

parameters.help_en: The O\&M approval setting in the control policy
parameters.help_zh: 控制策略中的运维审批配置
parameters.name: approval_config

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
